app.name: Kola
app.tagline: Save together. Everyone pays, or everyone gets their money back.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Kola
onboarding.body: Save with your group. Everyone pays their share, or everyone gets their money back.
pin.label: PIN
pin.createHelp: You will use it to open Kola on this phone. Nobody can recover it for you, so pick one you will remember.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs are different. Please start again.
pin.invalid: Your PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
unlock.title: Enter your PIN
unlock.wait: Too many tries. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
receive.title: Receive money
receive.show: Show this code to the person paying you, or copy it and send it to them.
pay.title: Pay
pay.confirmAmount: You are about to pay {amount} sats.
pay.inFlight: Your payment is still being delivered. Check your activity in a minute before trying again.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.moneyStill: Your money is still in your wallet.
errors.moneyUnknown: We could not confirm whether the payment went through. Check your activity before you try again.
errors.unauthorized: We could not confirm it is you. Check that your phone's date and time are correct, then try again.
errors.invalid_request: Something in the request was not right. Please check and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.no_wallet: Your wallet is not set up yet.
errors.no_wallet_available: All demo wallets are already in use. Ask the organizer to reset the demo.
errors.wallet_unavailable: Your wallet cannot be reached right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalid_invoice: This does not look like a payment request.
errors.wrong_network: This payment request is for a different network and cannot be paid here.
errors.no_amount: This payment request has no amount. Ask for one that includes the amount.
errors.wrong_amount: The amount is not the one expected.
errors.expired: This payment request has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.over_payment_cap: This is more than the limit for a single payment.
errors.over_daily_cap: This would go over today's spending limit.
errors.payment_failed: The payment did not go through.
errors.payment_status_unknown: We lost contact with your wallet during the payment.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
